text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D after large gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding’s future prospects and its role in my portfolio.","My account value moved sharply even when I made no trades, so I should expect volatility and avoid reacting to short-term price changes that do not predict what comes next.","I should make deliberate decisions based on risk, diversification, and my investment plan—not on the satisfaction of locking in gains or the discomfort of realizing losses."]}
